pages.text: $(bold)Redstone Dust$() is wire on the ground. It powers what it touches and carries signal up to fifteen blocks before fading. It climbs the sides of full blocks but not down a sheer drop.$(br2)A $(bold)Block of Redstone$() is a permanent power source — always on, and pushable by pistons.
pages.title: Dust

pages.text: $(bold)Strong vs weak power.$() A powered $(italic)component$() (torch, lever) strongly powers the block it sits on; that block then $(italic)weakly$() powers adjacent dust and devices. Weak power runs machines but won't re-power more dust.$(br2)This is why a lamp lights through a wall but the dust beyond it stays dark — the wall is weakly powered.
pages.title: Strong & Weak
